title: Generative AI for Full Stack Developers
overview: This course is designed to equip Full Stack Developers with the knowledge and skills to integrate Generative AI into modern web applications. It covers both frontend and backend AI integrations, focusing on AI-powered chatbots, content generation, intelligent automation, AI-driven recommendations, and code optimization.

Developers will learn how to leverage AI models like GPT, LLaMA, Stable Diffusion, and Hugging Face APIs to enhance user experiences, improve productivity, and optimize application workflows. By the end of the course, participants will be able to build AI-powered full-stack applications that are scalable, efficient, and user-centric.
audience: Full Stack Developers looking to integrate AI into web applications.
Frontend Engineers interested in AI-powered UX/UI enhancements.
Backend Developers working with AI-based APIs and automation.
Tech Leads & Architects designing AI-driven application architectures.
AI Enthusiasts & Data Engineers looking to merge AI with web development.
methodology: This course follows a hands-on, project-based approach, including:
Instructor-led lectures & live coding – Concept explanations and AI tool demonstrations.
Practical assignments & case studies – Applying AI in real-world web applications.
Interactive coding labs – Implementing AI-powered features in full-stack projects.
Capstone project – Developing and deploying a full AI-powered web application.
competencies: By the end of the course, participants will be proficient in:
Integrating AI models into frontend and backend architectures.
Building AI-powered chatbots, recommendation engines, and search features.
Optimizing full-stack applications with AI-driven automation.
Deploying AI-enhanced applications on cloud platforms.
Using AI to generate, debug, and optimize code for full-stack development.
objectivesIntro: Upon completing the course, participants will:
objectives: Build and deploy full-stack applications with AI-powered features.
Implement AI-enhanced chatbots, search engines, and recommendation systems.
